title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Receivables Desk Note — Payments Returned Unpaid
content:
When the business's bank returns a Ridgeline Pro Credit payment unpaid, the payment is added back to the account line by line, and the invoices it had settled reopen.

## What a returned payment books

| Entry | Rule |
|---|---|
| Returned payment lines | Every payment line of the returned payment is added back as its own returned payment line referencing it. |
| Reopened invoices | The invoices the payment had settled reopen. |
| Discount recapture | A prompt-payment discount earned by the returned payment is recaptured by a discount recapture fee for the full discount, referencing the discount entry. A replacement payment does not re-earn the discount. |
| Returned payment fee | One returned payment fee of the tier's returned payment fee is charged per returned payment, referencing its first returned line. |

## Limits

- A payment line that already has a returned payment line referencing it cannot be returned again.
- The fee is charged once per returned payment, however many invoice lines the payment had touched.

## Hypothetical example

A check of 3000.00 on a Commercial Account Net 45 had been applied as two payment lines, 2000.00 to one invoice and 1000.00 to another, and the 2000.00 line had earned a prompt-payment discount of 20.00. When the bank returns the check, two returned payment lines of 2000.00 and 1000.00 are added back, both invoices reopen, a discount recapture of 20.00 is charged referencing the discount, and one returned payment fee of 35.00 is charged referencing the 2000.00 returned line. A replacement payment made afterwards does not earn the 20.00 discount again.
